HENU Platform API Setup Guide

henu-platform-api is the NestJS backend and source of truth for identity, application inventory, GitHub release ingestion, and catalogue management.

---

1. Prerequisites #

  • Node.js: v20+ LTS
  • Docker: For local PostgreSQL (or external PostgreSQL 15+ database)
  • Git

---

2. Environment Configuration #

Copy the example environment file and configure local credentials:

bash 
cd henu-platform-api
cp .env.example .env

Essential Environment Variables #

VariableDescriptionExample (Development)
NODE_ENVRuntime environmentdevelopment
PORTAPI server listen port3000
DATABASE_URLPostgreSQL Prisma connection stringpostgresql://henu_admin:@localhost:5432/henu_platform?schema=public
JWT_ACCESS_SECRETSecret key for access token signingminimum_32_characters_random_secret_key_123
JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRATIONAccess token lifespan15m
JWT_REFRESH_SECRETSecret key for rotating refresh tokensanother_minimum_32_characters_refresh_secret
JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRATIONRefresh token lifespan7d
GITHUB_APP_IDGitHub App ID123456
GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEYRSA Private Key for GitHub App authBase64 or PEM string
GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRETHMAC Webhook secretyour_github_webhook_secret_here
CORS_ORIGINSPermitted origins for frontend communicationhttp://localhost:3001,http://localhost:5173
---

3. Database Initialization & Migrations #

Start the local PostgreSQL container via Docker Compose:

bash 
docker-compose up -d postgres

Verify PostgreSQL is running:

bash 
docker ps

Apply Prisma database migrations:

bash 
npm run prisma:migrate:dev

Generate Prisma client:

bash 
npm run prisma:generate

---

4. Initial Admin User Provisioning #

To prevent insecure default credentials, henu-platform-api does not provide a public admin registration endpoint. Use the secure CLI seeding script to provision your initial Super Admin:

bash 
# Provide temporary bootstrap credentials via environment variables
BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL="admin@henuos.com" \
BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD="<choose-a-strong-secret-password-min-12-chars>" \
BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_NAME="System Administrator" \
npm run seed:admin

The script:

  1. Hashes the password using Argon2id (memory cost 64MB, 3 iterations, 4 parallelism).
  2. Assigns the SUPER_ADMIN role.
  3. Generates TOTP MFA recovery codes.

---

5. Starting the Service #

Development Mode #

bash 
npm run start:dev

Production Mode #

bash 
npm run build
npm run start:prod

---

6. Verification & Probes #

EndpointMethodExpected StatusPurpose
http://localhost:3000/api/v1/health/liveGET200 OKLiveness probe
http://localhost:3000/api/v1/health/readyGET200 OKReadiness probe (verifies database)
http://localhost:3000/api/docsGET200 OKInteractive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation
http://localhost:3000/api/v1/hub/catalogueGET200 OKPublic application catalogue (ETag enabled)

7. Automated Testing #

End-to-end integration tests (requires test database)
